speaker: worker
text: I am John Smith, CPS worker, I am here to discuss a concern reported about your child Jill Carter.

speaker: worker
text: Our agency has a recording tool that will transcribe our conversation today for accuracy and to assist with any issues that may be identified during our conversation. May I use that tool?

speaker: parent
text: Yes, you may use that tool.

speaker: worker
text: I am turning on the tool and asking each person in the interview to please consent to being recorded.

speaker: parent
text: I consent

speaker: child
text: I consent

speaker: worker
text: Jill, before we talk more, can you tell me how old you are and what grade you are in?

speaker: child
text: I'm seven. I'm in second grade.

speaker: worker
text: Our agency received a report that Jill came to school with a black eye. It was reported that a man named Dave, who she was left with while you were working Mom, hit her in the eye with a cup he threw at her. It is reported she said this man is often her caregiver and often gets angry and hits her with objects.

speaker: parent
text: Dave is my boyfriend and lives here. His name is Dave Mercer, and he is not abusive at all to anyone. I just am having a hard time believing it. Jill told me she fell and hit her face and that is what caused the bruising.

speaker: worker
text: Thank you for telling me that. When did you first notice the bruise, and what do you know about how it happened?

speaker: parent
text: I saw it Tuesday night when I got home from work. She said she tripped on the stairs here at the house.

speaker: worker
text: Who was with Jill that day while you were at work?

speaker: parent
text: Dave was here, he's here most days. But he was out in the garage working on his truck, he didn't see anything.

speaker: worker
text: Has Jill been seen by a doctor or nurse about her eye?

speaker: parent
text: No, it's just a bruise. It didn't seem that bad.

speaker: child
text: I don't remember what happened. Dave is sometime mean and I am afraid of him. He said he does not think he should be responsible for me when Mom is working.

speaker: worker
text: Jill, when you said he is mean, can you give me any additional information on what mean is to you and how he acts mean with you.

speaker: parent
text: Dave is not mean and enjoys his time with Jill

speaker: child
text: I don't know, he just scares me.

speaker: worker
text: Jill, you said he scares you. Can you tell me about a time you felt scared?

speaker: child
text: When he yells.

speaker: parent
text: Please leave now, I am to upset to continue.
